name: io.github.thedhruv-07/github-repo-mcp
description: MCP server for GitHub repo health, commit summaries, issue triage, and RAG Q&A.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GitHub personal access token (classic, no scopes needed for public repos). Raises the rate limit from 60/hr to 5000/hr. https://github.com/settings/tokens

environmentVariables.name: VOYAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Voyage AI API key, required for ask_repo's embeddings. Free tier at https://dashboard.voyageai.com/

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Qdrant Cloud cluster URL, required for ask_repo's vector storage. Free tier at https://cloud.qdrant.io/

environmentVariables.name: QDRANT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for your Qdrant Cloud cluster.
